systems.system: Système d'information pour la gestion de l'éducation (SIGE)
systems.owner: Ministry of National Education; supported by external partners
systems.tiers: central to school level; supports an annual statistical yearbook (the compact says capacity is missing from the centre down to the school)

note: The compact describes the SIGE only as producing the annual statistical yearbook, funded externally with no permanent mechanism, so it is a census; it states nothing on school-level learner records, so no fact for the emis class.
